title: Registered Internet Supply Pharmacy
body:
McCormack's Pharmacy is a registered Internet Supply Pharmacy with the Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland (PSI). All transactions and prescription dispensing through our online store are subject to the same regulatory standards as our seven in-store pharmacies.

A record of each online pharmacy transaction is retained for two years in accordance with PSI requirements.
